Name: Growable Cannabis Mod (Early Alpha)
Author: kyblitz
Description:
WARNING: THIS CURRENTLY REQUIRES [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93/?]CJB'S ITEM SPAWNER MOD[/url], AND THEREFORE [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url].
This mod currently adds in cannabis seeds which can be grown in to weed and be sold. Currently the seeds must be spawned in using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93/?]CJB Item Spawner[/url], I am working on resolving this. Features I am working on right now are the ability to use it as an ingredient for baking, an npc that buys and sells seeds and other related items, the ability for it to be crafted in to a joint and be smoked, and effects of said smoking. Updates will be posted in the coming days and weeks.
